package internalapi_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	internalapi "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

func TestT14AssignedLessonContextRouteRegistered(t *testing.T) {
	router := internalapi.NewRouter(&internalapi.Handler{}, "fixture-token")
	r := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/learning-paths/22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222/items/33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333/lesson-context", nil)
	r.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "fixture-token")
	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	if w.Code != http.StatusServiceUnavailable {
		t.Fatalf("registered unconfigured read should return 503, got %d", w.Code)
	}
}

type t14PrivateReader struct {
	calls int
	err   error
}

func (reader *t14PrivateReader) GetLearningPathByID(_ context.Context, studentID, pathID string) (domain.StudentLearningPath, error) {
	reader.calls++
	if reader.err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningPath{}, reader.err
	}
	if studentID != "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111" || pathID != "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222" {
		return domain.StudentLearningPath{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return domain.StudentLearningPath{ID: pathID, StudentID: studentID, CourseID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{ID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", LessonRevisionID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", LessonContent: json.RawMessage(`{"title":"frozen","excerpt":"","description":"old body"}`)}}}, nil
}

func TestT14PrivateAssignedContextSharedReadTokenAndOwnership(t *testing.T) {
	const endpoint = "/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/learning-paths/22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222/items/33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333/lesson-context"
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, token, url string
		err              error
		status, calls    int
	}{
		{"shared read", "fixture-token", endpoint, nil, 200, 1},
		{"missing token", "", endpoint, nil, 403, 0},
		{"wrong token", "wrong", endpoint, nil, 403, 0},
		{"teacher command token", "teacher-token", endpoint, nil, 403, 0},
		{"planner command token", "planner-token", endpoint, nil, 403, 0},
		{"foreign owner", "fixture-token", "/students/77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777/learning-paths/22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222/items/33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333/lesson-context", nil, 404, 1},
		{"foreign path", "fixture-token", "/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/learning-paths/77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777/items/33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333/lesson-context", nil, 404, 1},
		{"foreign item", "fixture-token", "/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/learning-paths/22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222/items/77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777/lesson-context", nil, 404, 1},
		{"missing frozen content", "fixture-token", endpoint, domain.ErrValidation, 400, 1},
		{"outage", "fixture-token", endpoint, errors.New("fixture unavailable"), 500, 1},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			reader := &t14PrivateReader{err: tc.err}
			router := internalapi.NewRouter(&internalapi.Handler{AssignedLessons: studentuc.AssignedLessonContext{Paths: reader}}, "fixture-token", "planner-token", "teacher-token", "practice-token")
			r := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, tc.url, nil)
			r.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", tc.token)
			w := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(w, r)
			if w.Code != tc.status || reader.calls != tc.calls {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d calls=%d body=%s", w.Code, reader.calls, w.Body.String())
			}
			if tc.status == 200 {
				var result domain.AssignedLessonContext
				if json.Unmarshal(w.Body.Bytes(), &result) != nil || result.Schema != domain.AssignedLessonContextSchema || result.Content.Title != "frozen" || w.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" {
					t.Fatalf("bad frozen read %s", w.Body.String())
				}
			}
		})
	}
}
